spans.text: The underground shelter lies in complete silence. The faint glow of a terminal is the only light source in the room.
...There is not much time left before the final moment.
Before then, I must double and triple check that this plan is absolutely foolproof.
We won't get another shot at this, so any variable, no matter how minute or insignificant... must be eliminated through this simulation.
Countless paths unfold before me, simulating every possible outcome.
What I need is to find the one true path—the one that will allow me to end him with my own hands.
